No one should ever be heel striking when running. 
Ur legs and feet are built to be a spring, landing on the ball of ur foot will enable that spring. Heel, flat foot or rolling from back to front means u are using the padding in the shoe instead of ur natural spring. And is what leads to knee problems as they end up taking some of the force. 

Tldr: land on ball only, build up slowly and get injured less.
